newsitem.title: UK: BAe says Airbus float a long term possibility.
newsitem.headline: BAe says Airbus float a long term possibility.

text.p: British Aerospace Plc (BAe) said on Monday it regarded an eventual share flotation for Airbus Industrie as "a long term possibility" after the corporate restructuring due for completion by 1999.
Airbus announced earlier that its four partners had signed a memorandum of understanding to convert Airbus from a cooperative into an autonomous limited liability company by 1999.
"A stockmarket listing is a long term possibility after the Single Corporate Entity is up and running," a BAe spokesman said when asked if BAe wanted an eventual flotation.
Airbus had said that a stock market listing was among the long-term options for allowing external partners into the group.

Under the current Groupement d'Interet Economique cooperative structure Germany's Daimler Aerospace, and French group Aerospatiale each hold 38 percent of Airbus, British Aerospace has 20 percent and Construcciones Aeronauticas SA of Spain four percent.
